# Third-party references

DadsBetterVal is an independent implementation. Its requested feature set references these projects and authors:

- AzuAreaRepair by Azumatt
- Recycle_N_Reclaim by Azumatt (MIT)
- AzuClock by Azumatt
- BetterSmelting by Ruijven
- BuildRestrictionTweaks by aedenthorn (public domain), distributed on Thunderstore as NoBuildRestriction by BlackViking

No icons, textures, models, or other artwork from those projects are included. The package icon is original DadsBetterVal artwork.
